title: It's super cute but the storage is not safe
text: It's super cute but the storage is not safe. So I actually left a 5 star on this before but I'm updating it because the door closes in a very scary and u safe way that can seriously injure or hurt kids hands or fingers. product_metadata.title: DHP Davina Upholstered Bed with Storage Chest for Kids, Twin Size, Pink Velvet
features: Modern velvet upholstered bed with squared Detailing and tufting on headboard and plastic legs with wood look finish.
Small space living approved with versatile storage Chest foot Board. Includes air vents holes and storage Chest can be installed to open on either side.

Robust wood frame Construction that includes side rails and additional metal legs to Ensure stability and support. Bentwood slat support System that eliminates the Need for a box Spring additional foundation and adapts to pressure exerted on them.

description: Showcase your unique personality with the one of a kind DHP Davina upholstered bed with storage chest. This modern styled bed features squared tufted detailing on its headboard and plastic legs with a wooden look finish. The Davina has a special storage chest footboard that can be installed to open on either side and has practical air vent holes. For any small living space, This additional storage space is perfect to store personal belongings like books, accessories and more. Its robust wooden frame includes side rails and additional metal legs to ensure maximum support and stability. But wait there’s more! The bentwood slat support system not only adapts to the pressure exerted on it But it also eliminates The need for additional foundation or box spring. Ships in one easy to handle box and assembles quickly. Available in velvet or linen upholstery in multiple colors and sizes. The DHP Davina upholstered bed is the perfect furnishing option for any small living space.
